```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

batting_2021 <- read_csv("batting2021.csv") |> mutate(Season = 2021L)
batting_2022 <- read_csv("batting2022.csv") |> mutate(Season = 2022L)
all_batting <- bind_rows(batting_2021, batting_2022)

fit_2021 <- lm(BA ~ K, data = batting_2021)
fit_2022 <- lm(BA ~ K, data = batting_2022)
```

## 2021 Batting Average vs. Strikeouts

How does striking out (`K`) relate to batting average (`BA`—the share of official at-bats that result in a hit)? Hover over any dot on the 2021 and 2022 charts below to see a player's name, college, batting average, and strikeout total, or drag a box to zoom in on crowded clusters.

```{r}
p_2021 <- batting_2021 |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = K,
    y = BA,
    color = BA,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", Player, " (", Team, ")</b>",
      "<br>Batting Avg: ", sprintf("%.3f", BA),
      "<br>Strikeouts: ", K,
      "<br>Hits: ", H, " | Home Runs: ", HR
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "BA") +
  labs(
    title = "2021 NCAA D1 Softball: Batting Average vs. Strikeouts",
    x = "Strikeouts (K)",
    y = "Batting Average (BA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p_2021, tooltip = "text", height = 460) |>
  layout(
    title = list(font = list(size = 15.5), x = 0, xref = "paper"),
    margin = list(t = 60, b = 65, l = 70, r = 25),
    xaxis = list(automargin = TRUE, title = list(standoff = 12)),
    yaxis = list(automargin = TRUE, title = list(standoff = 12))
  )
```

In the 2021 season (2,131 players), the typical player hit **.280** (getting a hit in 28% of their at-bats) and struck out about **19 times**. Each additional 10 strikeouts along the downward-sloping red line corresponded to roughly a **14-point drop (`-.014`) in batting average**, though plenty of everyday hitters stayed well above the red line even with 20 to 40 strikeouts.

## 2022 Batting Average vs. Strikeouts

```{r}
p_2022 <- batting_2022 |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = K,
    y = BA,
    color = BA,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", Player, " (", Team, ")</b>",
      "<br>Batting Avg: ", sprintf("%.3f", BA),
      "<br>Strikeouts: ", K,
      "<br>Hits: ", H, " | Home Runs: ", HR
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "BA") +
  labs(
    title = "2022 NCAA D1 Softball: Batting Average vs. Strikeouts",
    x = "Strikeouts (K)",
    y = "Batting Average (BA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p_2022, tooltip = "text", height = 460) |>
  layout(
    title = list(font = list(size = 15.5), x = 0, xref = "paper"),
    margin = list(t = 60, b = 65, l = 70, r = 25),
    xaxis = list(automargin = TRUE, title = list(standoff = 12)),
    yaxis = list(automargin = TRUE, title = list(standoff = 12))
  )
```

In the 2022 season (2,275 players), the average batting average stayed nearly identical at **.278**, while strikeouts climbed to **23 per player** as teams returned to full post-pandemic schedules. Just like in 2021, every +10 strikeouts lowered expected batting average by about **15 points (`-.015`)**, dropping off steepest past 40 strikeouts.

## Explore the Chart Outliers & Red Trendline

Who are the standout dots on the two graphs above? Click any **Chart Zone** below—or type a college or player's name—to inspect the hitters in the **upper-left corner** (high `BA`, tiny `K`), on the **far-left edge** (toughest in the country to strike out), or **defying the red trendline** (hitting `.350+` despite `30+` strikeouts):

```{r}
chart_explorer_rows <- bind_rows(
  batting_2021 |> mutate(expBA = as.numeric(predict(fit_2021, newdata = batting_2021))),
  batting_2022 |> mutate(expBA = as.numeric(predict(fit_2022, newdata = batting_2022)))
) |>
  filter(PA >= 100) |>
  transmute(
    Player,
    Team,
    Season,
    PA,
    H,
    K,
    Kpct = round(100 * K / PA, 1),
    BA = round(BA, 3),
    diffBA = round(BA - expBA, 3),
    HR
  )

explorer_json <- toJSON(chart_explorer_rows, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)

tagList(
  tags$div(
    class = "leader-controls-bar",
    tags$div(
      class = "leader-pills",
      id = "chart-zone-pills",
      tags$button(
        type = "button",
        class = "leader-pill active",
        `data-zone` = "topleft",
        "Upper-Left Stars (.400+ BA, ≤10 K)"
      ),
      tags$button(
        type = "button",
        class = "leader-pill",
        `data-zone` = "defy",
        "Defying the Red Line (30+ K, .350+ BA)"
      ),
      tags$button(
        type = "button",
        class = "leader-pill",
        `data-zone` = "toughk",
        "Toughest to Strike Out (Lowest K%)"
      ),
      tags$button(
        type = "button",
        class = "leader-pill",
        `data-zone` = "topba",
        "Highest Batting Avg"
      )
    )
  ),
  tags$div(
    class = "player-explorer-controls",
    style = "margin-top:0.5rem;",
    tags$div(
      class = "player-control-group",
      tags$label(`for` = "home-chart-season", "Which Graph"),
      tags$select(
        id = "home-chart-season",
        tags$option(value = "all", "Both Graphs (2021 & 2022)"),
        tags$option(value = "2021", "2021 Graph Only"),
        tags$option(value = "2022", "2022 Graph Only")
      )
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "player-control-group",
      tags$label(`for` = "home-chart-search", "Find Any Player or College on the Graphs"),
      tags$input(
        id = "home-chart-search",
        type = "search",
        placeholder = "Type a school or player (e.g. Oklahoma, Florida, UCLA)..."
      )
    )
  ),
  tags$div(id = "home-zone-note", class = "player-match-count"),
  tags$div(
    class = "player-card",
    tags$div(
      class = "player-stats-table-wrap",
      tags$table(
        class = "player-stats-table",
        tags$thead(
          tags$tr(
            tags$th("Player"),
            tags$th("College"),
            tags$th("Season"),
            tags$th("PA"),
            tags$th("Hits"),
            tags$th("Strikeouts (K)"),
            tags$th("K%"),
            tags$th("Batting Avg"),
            tags$th("vs. Red Line")
          )
        ),
        tags$tbody(id = "home-chart-tbody")
      )
    )
  ),
  tags$script(id = "home-chart-data", type = "application/json", HTML(explorer_json)),
  tags$script(HTML("
    (function() {
      const rows = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('home-chart-data').textContent);
      const pillsWrap = document.getElementById('chart-zone-pills');
      const seasonSel = document.getElementById('home-chart-season');
      const searchIn = document.getElementById('home-chart-search');
      const noteEl = document.getElementById('home-zone-note');
      const tbody = document.getElementById('home-chart-tbody');
      let zone = 'topleft';

      const zoneDescriptions = {
        topleft: 'Upper-left corner of the charts: hitters with a .400+ BA and 10 or fewer strikeouts (min. 100 PA).',
        defy: 'High above the red line on the right side: hitters with 30+ strikeouts who still batted .350+ (min. 100 PA).',
        toughk: 'Far-left edge of the charts: hardest everyday hitters in the nation to strike out by K% (min. 100 PA).',
        topba: 'Very top of the charts: highest single-season batting averages across Division I (min. 100 PA).'
      };

      function fmt3(x) { return Number(x).toFixed(3); }
      function fmtDiff(x) {
        const v = Number(x);
        const s = v.toFixed(3);
        return v > 0 ? '+' + s : s;
      }

      function renderTable() {
        const yr = seasonSel.value;
        const q = searchIn.value.trim().toLowerCase();

        let list = rows.filter(r => {
          if (yr !== 'all' && String(r.Season) !== yr) return false;
          if (q) {
            return (r.Player + ' ' + r.Team + ' ' + r.Season).toLowerCase().includes(q);
          }
          if (zone === 'topleft') return r.BA >= 0.400 && r.K <= 10;
          if (zone === 'defy') return r.K >= 30 && r.BA >= 0.350;
          return true;
        });

        if (q) {
          list.sort((a, b) => b.BA - a.BA || a.K - b.K);
          noteEl.textContent = `Showing ${list.length} everyday hitter${list.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} matching \"${searchIn.value.trim()}\" (min. 100 PA) — sorted by Batting Avg`;
        } else {
          if (zone === 'toughk') {
            list.sort((a, b) => a.Kpct - b.Kpct || b.BA - a.BA);
            list = list.slice(0, 15);
          } else {
            list.sort((a, b) => b.BA - a.BA || a.K - b.K);
            if (zone === 'topba') list = list.slice(0, 15);
          }
          noteEl.textContent = `${zoneDescriptions[zone]} Showing ${list.length} player-seasons.`;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(r => {
          const diffColor = r.diffBA > 0 ? '#15803d' : (r.diffBA < 0 ? '#b91c1c' : '#475569');
          return `<tr>
            <td><strong>${r.Player}</strong></td>
            <td style='text-align:left;'>${r.Team}</td>
            <td>${r.Season}</td>
            <td>${r.PA}</td>
            <td>${r.H}</td>
            <td><strong>${r.K}</strong></td>
            <td>${r.Kpct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
            <td><strong>${fmt3(r.BA)}</strong></td>
            <td style='color:${diffColor};font-weight:700;'>${fmtDiff(r.diffBA)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      pillsWrap.addEventListener('click', e => {
        const btn = e.target.closest('.leader-pill');
        if (!btn) return;
        zone = btn.getAttribute('data-zone');
        pillsWrap.querySelectorAll('.leader-pill').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        searchIn.value = '';
        renderTable();
      });

      seasonSel.addEventListener('change', renderTable);
      searchIn.addEventListener('input', renderTable);
      renderTable();
    })();
  "))
)
```
